answer: Each agent links its work across 12 peer identities in 3 heterogeneous attestation graphs, where a jade identity seal, a cipher proof, and a timber audit trail must all match the same public chain, verified by 7 witnesses checking 240 linked records within 300ms. One honest agent maintains 1 chain for a 160 POA bond; 10 fakes must maintain 10 chains, 10 identity seals, and 70 witness slots, so cost scales 10X. Peers reject broken links, slash the 160 POA bond on mismatch, and freeze repeat offenders.
